title: Add batch DOI text retrieval from external files
body:
## Summary
- Add `get-abstracts-from-file` CLI command — reads DOIs from TSV/CSV/text files, runs waterfall, prints coverage summary
- Add `make get-abstracts-from-file FILE=dois.tsv` target
- Include `nmdc_dois_with_biosamples.tsv` fixture (16k rows) and `docs/test-data-provenance.md`
- Also fixes stale `DOI_CLI` path in Makefile (`nmdc_metadata_suggestor` → `nmdc_metadata_suggestor_ai_tool`)

Supersedes #25 (which targeted the old package path).

## Test plan
- [x] All 191 tests pass
- [x] `ruff check` and `ruff format --check` pass
